evidence.finding: SGA Mercure is the CPO supervision platform; SGA provides card payment and operator-configurable charging services.
Mercure manages stations and charging points; no anonymous station-to-current-direct-tariff resolver was exposed in this first pass.

decision.reason: First-party Mercure platform and direct payment are proven, but tariffs are host/operator configurable and no deterministic anonymous national station/EVSE direct-tariff resolver was recovered. Do not extrapolate a national tariff; roaming remains fallback only.
